name: exchange chain for state transfer
question: Does a flipped spin travel from one end of a four-spin exchange chain to the other?
assumptions: Closed unitary dynamics; hbar = 1; energies and rates in one arbitrary unit.
One spin flipped against a polarized chain (the sector sum_j Z_j = 2).
The observable is the position of the flipped spin, sum_j (j - 3/2)(1 - Z_j)/2.

provenance.reference: M. Christandl, N. Datta, A. Ekert and A. J. Landahl, Phys. Rev. Lett. 92, 187902 (2004)
